about.metaDescription: Extracurricular AI is an AI-native open collective making AI accessible to everyone through hands-on experimentation.
about.label: About ExAI
about.heroSubtitle: Extracurricular AI is an AI-native collective of builders, tinkerers, and learners — united by a belief that the best way to understand AI is to build real things with it, and that AI should be accessible to everyone who's curious.
about.originP1: ExAI started as a group of builders who wanted to work with AI the way they work with any other technology — by building real things, not just reading papers or watching tutorials.
about.originP2: We're AI-native by default: agents, LLMs, and inference are our everyday tools. But we're not exclusive about it. Old-school engineers, first-time learners, and everyone in between are just as welcome here.
about.originP3: Everything we build is open source. Everything we learn gets shared. That's the deal.
about.valuesSubtitle: These aren't mission statement buzzwords. They're how we actually operate.
about.githubBody: All of our projects, discussions, and code live in the open at github.com/extracurricular-ai.

projects.metaDescription: Open source AI projects built by the Extracurricular AI collective.
projects.label: Open Source Projects
projects.heroSubtitle: Real tools, shipped in the open. Everything below is free to use, fork, and contribute to.
projects.contributeBody: Open an issue, propose a project, or just jump into an existing one. All contributions welcome.
projects.odrDescription: An open replication of OpenAI's Deep Research. Features parallel background tasks, real-time streaming UI with Preact, and a full multi-agent pipeline. Built fast, shipped open — because that's how we learn.
projects.comingDescription: The collective is always experimenting. Watch the GitHub org for what's brewing next.

getInvolved.metaDescription: Join the Extracurricular AI collective — contribute to open source AI projects, share ideas, and build with us.
getInvolved.label: Join the Collective
getInvolved.heroSubtitle: No applications, no gatekeeping. Learner or builder, new to AI or a seasoned engineer — if you're curious, you're already in.
getInvolved.waysSubtitle: Every background and skill level welcome. Pick your entry point.
getInvolved.card1Body: Open a PR on an existing project, tackle an open issue, or propose something entirely new.
getInvolved.card2Body: Have an idea for a project or feature? Open a discussion or issue on GitHub.
getInvolved.card3Body: Star the repos, share with your network, or write about what we're building.
getInvolved.issuesBody: Check out open issues on our repos — we tag beginner-friendly tasks so you can find your footing without any friction.
getInvolved.finalBody: You don't need permission to contribute. Whether you're here to learn or to ship — just show up, dig in, and share what you find.

values.learnBody: The fastest way to learn AI is to build something real and put it in front of people. That goes for beginners and veterans alike.
values.openBody: Everything we make is public. No paywalls, no black boxes, no gatekeeping.
values.communityBody: Learners, builders, old-school engineers, AI newcomers, and the occasional AI agent 🤖 — every background matters. We grow together.
values.freeBody: Our tools are free for the community, always. That's non-negotiable.
